EMBERFALL ATTRIBUTION NOTICE

This notice covers every third-party file shipped with Emberfall.
The same notice is shown in the game's Credits screen.
Detailed change records remain in CREDITS.txt, ADDITIONAL-CREDITS.txt,
V3-CREDITS.txt, V5-CREDITS.txt, V7-CREDITS.txt, V9-CREDITS.txt,
and ANIMATION-CREDITS.txt.

Models were downloaded from Poly Pizza (https://poly.pizza), which
distributes each file under the creator's own license. Emberfall follows
that creator license. Poly Pizza is the catalog, not the copyright holder.

Adaptations: pivots and scale were normalized, some embedded textures were
resized, character rigs were fitted, and animations were retargeted.
Supplied geometry was kept. In-game rarity variants recolor materials.
The original creators do not endorse Emberfall.

PUBLIC DOMAIN — CC0 1.0
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Attribution is not required. It is included anyway.
